description_en: Queries the basic information about a metatable
description_zh: 该接口用于获取表的基础信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-table-basic-info --table-guid odps.engine_name.table_name --cluster-id abc --database-name abc --table-name abc --data-source-type emr --extension false --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaTableBasicInfo

parameters.description_en:
The GUID of the MaxCompute table. Specify the GUID in the odps.projectName.tableName format.

> This parameter is optional for E-MapReduce (EMR) tables.
parameters.description_zh:
MaxCompute表的唯一标识。格式为odps.projectName.tableName。

> EMR场景下，该参数非必选。

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the EMR cluster. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can log on to the [EMR console](https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou) to query the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
EMR集群的ID，当DataSourceType（数据类型）参数配置为EMR时，当前参数必配。

您可以登录[EMR的控制台](https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou)，获取集群ID。
